program.name: ESC ECU Design Rev C
program.fmea_team: Controls Team, Electrical Lead, Systems Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer
program.design_responsibility: Design: Supplier; Manufacturing: OEM Contract Facility

functions.function_statement: Prevent unintended yaw rotation by detecting wheel slip and applying corrective brake pressure
Monitor wheel speed from all four wheels in real-time
Measure vehicle yaw rate and lateral acceleration
Compute slip ratio and execute ESC algorithm with lockstep integrity
Apply brake pressure to individual wheels via solenoid drivers
Communicate ECU status and receive commands from vehicle network (CAN)

failure_modes.failure_mode: Wheel speed sensor signal loss (open circuit or corrosion)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Loss of speed feedback to Main MCU; speed channel shows zero
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: ESC algorithm cannot estimate slip; potential loss of yaw control; vehicle may spin out in emergency maneuver
failure_modes.failure_cause: Connector corrosion due to moisture ingress; potting compound not fully sealing connector entry point
failure_modes.prevention_control: Sealed connector design with hydrophobic membrane; potting process with high fill percentage validation
failure_modes.detection_control: CAN message timeout check (100 ms); on-board diagnostic triggers fault code; manufacturing potting 100% inspection
failure_modes.recommended_action: Increase connector sealing test duration to 1000 hrs salt-fog per ASTM B117; implement 100% potting visual + X-ray sampling in production

failure_modes.failure_mode: Lockstep mismatch in dual-core MCU undetected
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: One core executes incorrect ESC algorithm; cross-core check does not catch corruption due to design gap
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Unintended brake apply or brake inhibition; loss of vehicle control; safety-critical hazard
failure_modes.failure_cause: Single-bit flip in memory-mapped register not covered by lockstep checker; checker has blind spot in shadow memory region
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement comprehensive lockstep checker covering all critical registers; Fault Injection Analysis (FIA) to validate coverage
failure_modes.detection_control: Lockstep mismatch detector triggers immediate safe state (brake release, CAN alert); real-time watchdog every 10 ms
failure_modes.recommended_action: Run FIA on final MCU design with all process variations; extend checker to cover shadow registers; independent safety audit per ISO 26262 ASIL D

failure_modes.failure_mode: Brake solenoid stuck-on (always applies brake pressure)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Continuous brake pressure on one wheel; vehicle pulled to that side
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Vehicle slows and veers unexpectedly; loss of control; potential crash if on highway or during evasive maneuver
failure_modes.failure_cause: Solenoid spool seized due to particulate contamination in brake fluid or internal manufacturing defect
failure_modes.prevention_control: Brake fluid particle filtration (4-micron minimum); solenoid internal design review for contamination resistance; supplier qualification audit
failure_modes.detection_control: Pressure sensor feedback check (detects unexpected high pressure); on-board diagnostic monitors pressure vs. command; EMC testing for noise immunity
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement high-resolution pressure sensor (0.5 bar resolution); develop algorithm to detect stuck solenoid within 200 ms; validate with hardware-in-loop (HIL) testing

failure_modes.failure_mode: IMU yaw rate output drift over temperature range
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Computed yaw rate diverges from actual; slip detection becomes inaccurate; algorithm may over- or under-estimate correction
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Erratic ESC behavior; unwanted braking or brake inhibition; customer notices unstable handling in dynamic situations
failure_modes.failure_cause: IMU temperature coefficient not fully compensated in firmware; sensor aging or manufacturing tolerance stack-up of gyroscope bias
failure_modes.prevention_control: Firmware temperature compensation algorithm calibrated across full range (-40 to +85°C); component selection with low temperature coefficient specification
failure_modes.detection_control: Cross-check IMU yaw rate with wheel speed-derived yaw rate; algorithm flags large divergence as diagnostic warning; design validation testing includes thermal cycling
failure_modes.recommended_action: Perform temperature cycling test (-40 to +85°C, 100 cycles) with yaw rate logging; calibrate firmware compensation if drift exceeds ±2°/s; document thermal model

failure_modes.failure_mode: CAN message loss or corruption (bit error)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: ECU does not receive brake command from main controller or sends corrupted status; timeout triggers inhibition of ESC function
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: ESC function unavailable; vehicle without yaw control in emergency situation; safety risk if depends on ESC
failure_modes.failure_cause: EMI coupling to CAN bus from high-current brake solenoid switching; insufficient shielding or termination resistance out of tolerance
failure_modes.prevention_control: CAN bus shielding and twisted pair routing per automotive standard (ISO 11898); transceiver surge protection (±25 kV ESD); solenoid flyback diode and RC snubber
failure_modes.detection_control: CAN message CRC check and timeout monitor; ECU detects loss and enters safe state; manufacturing EMC test (conducted immunity per ISO 11452-4)
failure_modes.recommended_action: Perform conducted immunity (CI) testing up to 20A on CAN bus; validate shielding continuity 100% in assembly; implement watchdog timeout < 50 ms

failure_modes.failure_mode: Software timeout in main control loop not implemented; task misses execution deadline
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Algorithm iteration delayed; brake command not issued on time; ESC response latency > 100 ms spec
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Delayed ESC engagement during emergency maneuver; insufficient correction; potential vehicle instability or spin-out
failure_modes.failure_cause: Software scheduler does not enforce deadline; watchdog timer not implemented or disabled; real-time OS misconfiguration
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement hardware watchdog timer with 50 ms timeout; software code review checklist for real-time deadline compliance; RTOS configuration audit
failure_modes.detection_control: Watchdog fires on timeout; ECU enters safe state (brake release, CAN alert); integration test with load injection to verify deadline adherence
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement watchdog at hardware level (separate timer IC); validate with system-level testing under worst-case CPU load; document timing budget with margins

failure_modes.failure_mode: Wheel speed sensor intermittent signal (noise spikes, momentary loss)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Noisy speed feedback or periodic zero-crossings; algorithm sees false slip condition; ESC may apply brake incorrectly
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Unintended brake apply; vehicle jerks or lurches; customer experiences uncomfortable or unsafe handling
failure_modes.failure_cause: Connector pin oxidation causing intermittent contact; inadequate signal filtering; sensor connector vibration from mounting looseness
failure_modes.prevention_control: Gold-plated connector contacts; connectors rated for automotive temperature and vibration; mechanical strain relief design review
failure_modes.detection_control: Signal filtering (low-pass filter design validated); plausibility check (speed must be continuous, no step changes > threshold); diagnostic fault code on dropout
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement hardware filter (RC or active filter) with -3dB cutoff 5 kHz; software plausibility check: flag spike if speed change > 10 km/h in one sample period

failure_modes.failure_mode: Brake solenoid coil insulation breakdown (short to case ground)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Solenoid driver short-circuit; power supply current surge; driver IC may fail or shut down due to overcurrent detection
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Loss of brake actuation on that wheel; potential loss of ESC function; vehicle yaw control impaired
failure_modes.failure_cause: Coil insulation damaged by thermal cycling or contamination; solenoid coil manufacturing defect; inadequate voltage clamping
failure_modes.prevention_control: Solenoid supplier quality audit and AQL 0.65; over-voltage clamping circuit (TVS diode or active clamp) on solenoid supply; thermal stress test during design validation
failure_modes.detection_control: Driver IC monitors coil resistance (open-circuit detection + short-circuit detection); on-board diagnostic triggers DTC if anomaly detected; manufacturing solenoid insulation test (1.5 kV hi-pot)
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement high-side driver with integrated short-circuit protection and diagnostics; 100% hi-pot testing of solenoids in production (1.5 kV for 1 sec per IEC 60950)

failure_modes.failure_mode: CAN transceiver failure (stuck high or low, not driving bus)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: ECU cannot communicate; commands not received; status not sent; timeout occurs on vehicle controller side
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: ESC function disabled by master controller; vehicle loses electronic stability control; safety hazard in dynamic situation
failure_modes.failure_cause: Transceiver IC ESD damage during handling or assembly; thermal overstress; power supply transient (under-voltage spike)
failure_modes.prevention_control: ESD protection during manufacturing (grounding straps, static mat); transceiver surge protection (series resistor, ESD TVS); power supply filtering and regulation
failure_modes.detection_control: CAN bus monitor function checks transceiver response to message arbitration; timeout triggers safe state; manufacturing ESD test (per IEC 61000-4-2, ±8 kV contact)
failure_modes.recommended_action: Add series protection resistor (100 ohm) on CAN lines at transceiver input; implement power supply filtering (bulk + ceramic capacitors); validate ESD immunity test per OEM spec

failure_modes.failure_mode: Firmware algorithm division by zero or NaN propagation
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Computation returns invalid value (inf, NaN); subsequent algorithm step propagates invalid value; brake command may become erratic
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Unpredictable ESC behavior; unintended brake apply or complete loss of ESC function; safety hazard
failure_modes.failure_cause: Algorithm input plausibility check not implemented; edge case in denominator calculation (e.g., zero wheel speed difference); floating-point error handling missing
failure_modes.prevention_control: Input validation layer before algorithm execution; check denominators are non-zero; use fixed-point arithmetic if suitable; code review checklist for division and FP operations
failure_modes.detection_control: Output range check after algorithm; NaN/inf detection triggers safe state; unit and integration testing with edge-case injection
failure_modes.recommended_action: Add guard clause: if denominator < 0.1, skip algorithm iteration or use default safe value; implement NaN trap in firmware startup; unit test with edge cases (wheel speed = 0, extreme values)

failure_modes.failure_mode: MCU power supply transient (brown-out or spike) causes memory corruption
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: Data in RAM or NVM corrupted; algorithm state invalid; ECU behavior unpredictable
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Potential loss of ESC function or erratic behavior; safety risk if happens during dynamic driving
failure_modes.failure_cause: Solenoid switching transient on shared power supply; inadequate bulk capacitance; power supply filtering not sufficient
failure_modes.prevention_control: Dual power supplies (one for analog, one for digital); bulk capacitor (100+ uF) + ceramic (10 uF) right at MCU pins; power supply 3.3V regulation with transient response time < 1 us
failure_modes.detection_control: CRC check on critical data every 100 ms; ESD / transient immunity testing per ISO 11452-5 (transient burst); watchdog timer detects MCU hang
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement power supply filtering per MCU datasheet recommendations; add CRC calculation on algorithm state; validate transient immunity testing; document power budget and margins

failure_modes.failure_mode: IMU sensor initialization or calibration failure on power-up
failure_modes.failure_effect_next: IMU returns zero or invalid yaw rate from startup; algorithm does not detect bad sensor; uses wrong baseline for subsequent measurements
failure_modes.failure_effect_user: Initial ESC response incorrect or missing; if failure occurs during critical maneuver after power cycle, yaw control is impaired
failure_modes.failure_cause: Sensor communication bus (SPI, I2C) not initialized correctly; sensor self-test fails but error not checked in firmware; sensor clock not stable at startup
failure_modes.prevention_control: Firmware startup sequence includes sensor communication validation; sensor self-test result checked and reported; SPI/I2C initialization with timeout
failure_modes.detection_control: Startup diagnostic test (sensor present, responding, self-test pass); if test fails, DTC set and ECU enters limited function mode; design validation includes cold-start testing
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement sensor startup health check before algorithm enable; log diagnostic code if sensor initialization fails; validate over temperature range (-40 to +85°C) with cold soak test
